title: Elijah and Ahaziah

questions.question: Who rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:1 (ESV): "After the death of Ahab, Moab rebelled against Israel."

questions.question: How was Ahaziah injured?
options: He fell through the lattice in his upper chamber
questions.correctAnswer: He fell through the lattice in his upper chamber
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:2 (ESV): "Now Ahaziah fell through the lattice in his upper chamber in Samaria, and lay sick..."

questions.question: Which god did Ahaziah send messengers to inquire of?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:2 (ESV): "...Go, inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I shall recover from this sickness."

questions.question: What happened to the first two captains of fifty and their men?
options: Fire came down from heaven and consumed them
questions.correctAnswer: Fire came down from heaven and consumed them
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:10, 12 (ESV): "...Then fire came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty."

questions.question: What did the third captain do differently?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:13 (ESV): "...the third captain of fifty went up and came and fell on his knees before Elijah and entreated him..."

questions.question: Who told Elijah to go with the third captain?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:15 (ESV): "Then the angel of the LORD said to Elijah, 'Go down with him; do not be afraid of him.'"

questions.question: Because Ahaziah inquired of Baal-zebub, what was his punishment?
options: He would surely die and not come down from his bed
He would be sick for years
questions.correctAnswer: He would surely die and not come down from his bed
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:16 (ESV): "...therefore you shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die."

questions.question: Who reigned in Ahaziah's place because he had no son?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:17 (ESV): "Jehoram became king in his place... because Ahaziah had no son."

questions.question: What was Elijah wearing?
options: A garment of hair, with a belt of leather
questions.correctAnswer: A garment of hair, with a belt of leather
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:8 (ESV): "He wore a garment of hair, with a belt of leather about his waist."

questions.question: In whose second year did Jehoram begin to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:17 (ESV): "...in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah..."

questions.question: Where was Ahaziah when he fell?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:2 (ESV): "Now Ahaziah fell through the lattice in his upper chamber in Samaria..."

questions.question: What did the messengers describe Elijah as?
options: A man wearing a garment of hair
questions.correctAnswer: A man wearing a garment of hair
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:8 (ESV): "They answered him, 'He wore a garment of hair, with a belt of leather about his waist.'"

questions.question: How many captains in total were sent to Elijah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:9, 11, 13 (ESV): First, second, and third captains are mentioned.

questions.question: What did Elijah say to the first captain?
options: If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty
questions.correctAnswer: If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:10 (ESV): "...If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty."

questions.question: Where was Elijah sitting when the captains came?
options: On the top of a hill
questions.correctAnswer: On the top of a hill
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 1:9 (ESV): "...Elijah was sitting on the top of a hill."

key_verse_text: And he said to him, “Thus says the LORD, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron—is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word?—therefore you shall not come down from the bed to which you have gone up, but you shall surely die.’” (ESV)
